meta.title: A second late lead change extends again
gaps: The available setup recipes do not create a published rank auction with dynamic closing configured for a one-minute trigger, a two-minute extension, and three QA vendors.
There is no token or operation for QA vendor 3; only vendor and vendor2 are available.
The first-extension state from API-EVDAUX-001 cannot be carried into this plan.
The available assertions cannot verify that the end time moved by exactly two minutes relative to the prior end time.
